name: Wichita Public Schools
districtFact: Wichita's annual calendar separates the longer Student Winter Recess from a shorter Winter Recess period when administrative offices are closed, standardizes parent-teacher conference dates districtwide, and publishes the same school-year calendar in English, Spanish, and Vietnamese.
calendarNotes: Use the annual WPS School Year Calendar for districtwide dates such as the first and last student days, recesses, inservice days, conference-related closures, high school finals, and grading periods. The shorter Winter Recess range in the PDF refers to administrative-office closure and sits inside the longer Student Winter Recess. Spanish and Vietnamese files are official translations of the same district calendar, not separate attendance tracks. Building events and later revisions may appear on the live All Events page. Kindergarten families should follow their school's assigned opening schedule because WPS uses scheduled attendance days at the start of kindergarten. An imported ICS file is a one-time copy and will not update automatically if the district revises its calendar.

districtFaqs.q: Why does the Wichita calendar show two Winter Recess ranges?
districtFaqs.a: The longer Student Winter Recess is the period when students are out. A shorter Winter Recess range inside it marks when administrative offices are closed. Families should use the student range for attendance planning.

districtFaqs.q: What is a WPS Conference Release Day?
districtFaqs.a: WPS explains that a Conference Release Day recognizes evening hours worked during parent-teacher conferences. Students do not attend on the published release day.

districtFaqs.q: Are Wichita parent-teacher conference dates the same across the district?
districtFaqs.a: WPS standardizes the conference dates districtwide. The annual PDF identifies the conference range and the conference day when students do not attend. Families should still check their school for appointment times.

districtFaqs.q: Do all Wichita kindergarten students begin on the district's first day?
districtFaqs.a: Not necessarily. WPS says kindergarten students have scheduled attendance days during the first few days of school, and each school communicates the assigned schedule to families.

districtFaqs.q: Are the Spanish and Vietnamese Wichita calendars different schedules?
districtFaqs.a: No. They are official language versions of the same WPS school-year calendar. They are provided with the English PDF on each reviewed school-year page.
